meta.notes: A chest of 27 slots that joins a chest of the same stage beside it into a double chest of 54, as vanilla chests do (sneak to keep them apart). Ageing, waxing, scraping and lightning keep its items, and both halves change together. Hoppers and comparators work with each half. Mined with a stone pickaxe or better, as copper. Bronze Chest: on random ticks it slowly ages into the exposed stage, msm_examples:exposed_bronze_chest, by copper's own chance, and a lower-stage neighbour holds it back. Honeycomb waxes it into msm_examples:waxed_bronze_chest.
